pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10, 64-bit versions only
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6 core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1060 graphics card or an AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and AMD GPUs

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia, and AMD GPUs
